A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same TFPI study, including Appendices A–E. Their text, equations, figures, tables and embedded resource links support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original TFPI training and evaluation results, token-efficiency measurements, and behavioral and parameter analyses in Sections 3–5 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and analyses, including the benchmark results in Tables 1–3 and 7–8.

M1.justification: The ThinkingFree input transformation, TFPI initialization procedure, subsequent RLVR training and DAPO objectives remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A and C.

E1.justification: Both versions train on Polaris-53K and evaluate on AIME24/25, BeyondAIME, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench and IFEval. Section 4.1 relocates the existing in-domain/out-of-domain classification without changing coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3 and 7–8, including Direct RL and the external reasoning baselines. Changing 'direct RL' to 'Direct RL' in Table 1's caption is capitalization only.

E3.justification: Training budgets, response lengths, decoding settings, metrics and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Figure 2's added phrase 'under 4K training response length' repeats a setting already documented in v1's Section 3.2 and Appendix B.2.

E4.justification: Both retain the same thinking-free meta-experiments and the behavioral, parameter-space, reasoning-pattern and rollout analyses in Figures 2–5. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Generation counts, averaging conventions and uncertainty reporting remain unchanged. No seed information, repeated-run counts, uncertainty-estimation procedures or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged, including Table 2's 89.0% AIME24 and 65.5% LiveCodeBench results for Qwen3-4B-2507 with TFPI only. Appendix E's complete results in Tables 7–8 also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations (1)–(6), including the policy objectives and importance-ratio definitions, are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about faster RL convergence, higher attainable performance, cross-domain benefits and token efficiency.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations in Section 5, cross-domain qualifications and Appendix C.4's caveat about external results using different evaluation settings remain unchanged. Repositioning the domain-classification sentence does not alter its meaning.

D1.justification: On page 1, v1's GitHub and Models links both target the author's TFPI-temp GitHub repository. v2 directs them separately to Tencent-Hunyuan's Thinking-Free_Policy_Initialization repository and the xx18/tfpi Hugging Face collection. Other implementation and reproducibility details are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and Section 6's positioning relative to RLVR and efficient-reasoning research are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited editorial changes: it rearranges and repairs the evaluation-domain wording in Section 4.1, expands Figure 2's caption, standardizes 'Direct RL' capitalization and updates date/version markings. Section organization remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2's caption now explicitly states the 4K training response length, and Table 1's caption changes capitalization. The plots, table structures, placement and overall page layout remain unchanged apart from minor text reflow.

improvement.justification: v2 provides more useful resource directions by replacing the shared temporary-repository targets with separate project-code and model-collection links. Figure 2's caption becomes more self-contained, and Section 4.1 reads more clearly. These are limited access-information and presentation improvements; the scientific methods, evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
